mathematics.assertion_tested: For synthetic nonnegative integer counts, exact DP counts and global-rank backward unranking give a bijection onto ALL balanced subsets minimizing absolute photon imbalance. Every exact rank is checked on every count composition with N=2,4,6 and M=0..N; one mocked arbitrary-integer oracle call selects that rank without photon rejection. Independent brute-force combinations supply the expected minimizer sets. No graph or physical sampler is evaluated.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Python arbitrary-precision integers for multiplicities, DP counts and ranks; no floating point, NumPy, optical simulator or numerical optimizer
mathematics.conventions: Even N, K=N/2, M=sum(counts), error=abs(2*sum_selected_counts-M); all minimum-error targets weighted by their exact DP counts, one global uniform rank. Injected oracle must be uniform on arbitrary-size integer ranges. Law relabeling, not same-rank relabeling coupling. Out-of-domain or invalid-oracle failure is retained, never an instruction to resample a physical shot.
inputs: ALL compositions at N2/4/6 with total M0..N: exactly 1000 synthetic vectors, fewer than 20000 internal exact-rank/mock-oracle routes, not 20000 pytest items
Vacuum, one photon, all bunching and all-one counts; doublon/hole same-side condition; odd M without exact neutrality; M>N product-marginal-compatible inputs
Complement/relabeling law equality; N70/M0 arbitrary-integer ways above 2^64; input/DP-cell/rank guards before allocation or resampling
non_claims: No photonic optimization benefit, graph family, quantum advantage, full physical benchmark, held-out test, hardware compatibility or QPU validation
Prototype resource bounds are engineering failure limits, not postselection or a claim that the mathematical decoder fails outside this domain
Exact mock-rank enumeration establishes the combinatorial sampling map on the tested range, not the statistical quality or runtime of an external random-number generator
The DP and random-bit generation are classical work and must be charged in any future optimization comparison
No graph or photon sampler pilot follows this qualification without a separate frozen card, review and exclusive numerical slot; no automatic retry or budget increase

randomness.generator: Every admissible small exact rank is enumerated via a deterministic mock oracle; no random bits, graph seeds, phases or physical samples are drawn

checks.check: process exited successfully within enforced limits
declared result files are present and regular

result: Run completed; mathematical assertion requires interpretation and review.
residual_risks: Command success does not establish the mathematical interpretation.
Only listed input artifacts are pinned; external dependencies need recorded versions.
The thread cap uses conventional environment variables; a child program may ignore them.
The POSIX CPU-time limit is per process, not an aggregate descendant budget.
